Name: Erin's Coop Animals
Author: ErinMhidni
Description:
[size=2][center][color=#f4cccc]What started as a little hobby to learn pixel art, I ended up... actually making this. It's a retexture of all the coop animals in my own style, with a bonus raptor variant of the dinosaur that a very good friend of mine designed as we both adore them.[/color][/center][/size]
[left]﻿[/left][center][size=3][color=#f4cccc]   [u]Instructions:
[/u][/color][/size][color=#f4cccc][size=2]- Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url]﻿[b][/b] and[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][/b] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=2]- Extract the .zip into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
[color=#f4cccc][size=2]- You're done!

The game should load them, and if using the Alternative Textures version, use the scissors purchased from Robin and select whichever one you want! ♥
If using the Content Patcher version, simply edit the generated config file, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu
[/url]﻿

[/size][/color][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=3][u]Planned:[/u][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=2][color=#f4cccc][size=2]
- More variations
- Extra dino types

[/size][/color][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Barn animals are planned after a short break![/b][/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=2][color=#f4cccc][size=2] ♥


Please don't upload this anywhere else! This is [u][i]only[/i][/u] available on NexusMods. If you see it elsewhere, it's not mine!

[color=#f4cccc][size=2][color=#f4cccc][size=2]I hope you enjoy this little mod of mine! I certainly loved making it a beginner project for pixel art! ♥[/size][/color][/size][/color]
[/size][/color][/size][/color][/center]
